conviction_note: Q3 is fenced in by the company's own July guide ('similar level' to Q2's EUR 100m) and the consensus median (100m) sits exactly there, so the move is the Q4 guide. Two direct peers (Aperam on 6 Oct: European demand 'unchanged at a low level', order books not improving; Acerinox on 30 Oct: Q4 EBITDA below Q3) and the fall in nickel argue softly against the slight Q4 uptick consensus wants (104m). Every input is a peer or a proxy, the stock is already down 20% over 60 days, and the name has fallen on each of its last four prints, so p_up is only 43. The scaled number is (2*0.43-1)*7.0 = -0.98, close to the findings' sum of -1.1. The two measurements agree, and the result is small because the sign is uncertain, not because the move will be.

findings.finding: Aperam, the closest European stainless peer, said in its pre-quiet-period update that underlying European demand stayed 'unchanged at a low level in Q3 2026' with 'no clear improvement' in order books. It guided Q3 adj. EBITDA below Q2's EUR 130m and noted that significant pull-forward benefits had already landed in H1, ahead of the 1 July trade measures. EU cold-rolled 304 eased from $2,956/t in June to $2,880/t in September. This argues against the slight Q3-to-Q4 uptick that consensus (104m) asks of Outokumpu, whose Europe business is the swing segment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 guide (flat EBITDA, deliveries -0-10%) fell short of expectations on 2026-07-30 and the stock closed -7.58%. The Q4 2025 guide ('lower') came on 2025-10-29 and the stock fell 9.26%. Computed from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/OUT1V.HE?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: the stock is -5.9% over 20 days and -20% over 60. But the Q4 consensus of 104m, above the Q3 consensus of 100m and inside a Q4 window that is seasonally weak in Europe, shows the sell-side has not marked Outokumpu's Q4 down to Aperam's European read. If it had, Q4 consensus would sit at or below Q3.
findings.independence: Acerinox's Q3 release (30 Oct) says European domestic consumption is recovering 'at a slower pace than expected': https://www.democrata.es/en/economy/acerinox-multiplies-its-profit-by-23-and-earns-162-million-through-september/

findings.finding: LME nickel fell from a July monthly average of $17,064/t (Aperam's table) to $15,240/t cash on 30 Oct (Westmetall), and ferrochrome slipped from $2,384 to $2,294 over July-September. Falling alloy prices cut alloy surcharges and make the raw-material inventory and derivative gains in Outokumpu's July Q3 guide less likely. They also raise the risk that the Q4 guide flags inventory losses.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4 2025 guide (no major inventory effects, but 'lower' EBITDA) on 2025-10-29 drew -9.26%. No dated case was found of this name reacting to an inventory-loss flag on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Nickel is a public series, so the price is known. What is not known is whether it reaches the guide. This is macro-to-company transmission that the company has not confirmed, so it is sized small. If it were fully priced, Q3 consensus would sit below the guided 100m, and it sits exactly at it.
findings.independence: Aperam's Q3 trends update carries the July-September nickel and ferrochrome series (the same document as finding 1, for this datum only): https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/aperam-aperam-update-on-q3-2026-market-financial-trends-20261006

findings.finding: Acerinox, whose EBITDA is mostly US (North American Stainless), guided Q4 2026 EBITDA below Q3 on 'usual U.S. year-end seasonality'. That points to a seasonal step-down in Outokumpu's Americas segment in Q4, while the consensus Q4 group EBITDA (104m) sits above Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 guides have twice included a seasonal Americas slowdown: on 2025-10-29 the Q4'25 guide said deliveries would fall 5-15% partly on 'a seasonal slowdown in business area Americas', and the stock fell 9.26%.
findings.why_not_priced: Net of the rest of the company: Americas is the smaller segment and the CEO's July comment pointed to a flat Q3-to-Q4. A peer's seasonal guide only says Q4 is not a clean uptick, so the size is small. Cleveland-Cliffs' strong Q3 (Inderes forum, 23 Oct) cuts the other way for US pricing.
findings.independence: Outokumpu's own Q4 2025 guide cited a seasonal Americas slowdown: https://www.inderes.se/releases/outokumpu-oyj-outokumpu-interim-report-january-september-2025-adjusted-ebitda-was-eur-34-million-in-q3-reflecting-weakness-in-the-european-market

findings.finding: European stainless imports fell 42% in the first nine months of 2026 on CBAM and the new trade defence measures, per Acerinox's Q3 release. This structurally supports the European contract prices Outokumpu rolls into Q4 and is the upside case for Q4 commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 report's positive trade-measure commentary did not stop a -7.58% reaction on 2026-07-30. The market has paid for numbers on this name, not for the policy narrative.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. JPM (August) and BofA (Sept, Buy, EUR 6.70) built their notes on tighter EU supply, so only the confirmation that imports are already sharply down adds anything. It is sized small and kept because a sourced fact is filed. If it were unpriced, the stock would not be 20% off its July level.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative and agree with the falling tape (20d -5.9%, 60d -20.2%) rather than cut against it. The lean (+0.30) is the run-up term only, from the reversal-style free control, and it points mildly the other way. lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes move a median 9%): raised abs_move_pct from 6.5 to 7.0. Q4 is a new guide and this name's last four print reactions were 9.3, 6.4, 2.0 and 7.6%.
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': cut the nickel finding from -0.5 to -0.3.
'Net of the rest of the company': cut the Acerinox US-seasonality finding from -0.4 to -0.3, because Americas is the smaller segment.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' and 'largely priced': cut the import-decline positive from +0.4 to +0.3.

'Two findings resting on one document': stated that findings 1 and 2 share the Aperam release for the Q3 nickel series; kept them separate because they rest on different facts (demand vs alloy prices), and finding 2's October datum is from Westmetall.
